Desired feel: exceptionally clean, precise, contemporary developer tooling, editorial Swiss typography, quiet confidence. Wide horizontal banner, aspect ratio 3:1, about 1800 by 600. Background one perfectly flat almost-black ink color #101217. Center a compact horizontal lockup: at left an original striking geometric monogram representing a routed handoff, formed by two bold interlocking angular paths that subtly suggest the letter R; at right the exact wordmark 'RelayRook' in large warm-white #F4F1EA semibold modern grotesk lettering, meticulous kerning. The monogram is mainly warm white with exactly one solid signal-orange #FF6B35 segment. Icon and wordmark together occupy around 66 percent of the width, vertically centered with generous uninterrupted negative space. Only the word 'RelayRook' may appear. Keep the mark simple enough to recognize at 24px and strong in one color. Perfectly flat vector-like shapes and crisp edges. No chess pieces, castles, crowns, literal circuit boards, networks, robot heads, mascots, arrows radiating in multiple directions, gradients, light effects, glow, shadows, bevels, grain, texture, mockup surfaces, borders, badges, extra text, or watermarks. Output a finished standalone masthead, not a brand board or collection of variations.
